responsibility: Provides the OpenRISC bare-metal/newlib ELF target driver specs that control final link-time behavior rather than code generation itself. It overrides LIB_SPEC, LINK_SPEC, STARTFILE_SPEC, and ENDFILE_SPEC to choose the default board support library, entry address, C runtime startup objects, and end files for non-Linux OpenRISC ELF binaries.
same_name_distinction: This is the bare-metal ELF target configuration header: unlike elf.opt, which only declares driver options such as -mboard= and -mnewlib, this file consumes those options in target specs and defines the actual link/start/end file behavior through LIB_SPEC, LINK_SPEC, STARTFILE_SPEC, and ENDFILE_SPEC.
